articles.abstract_en: We revisit measurement of employer-to-employer (EE) transitions in the monthly Current Population Survey. The incidence of missing answers to the question on change of employer sharply increases starting with the introduction of a new software instrument to conduct interviews in January 2007 and of the Respondent Identification Policy in 2008–2009. We document nonrandom nonresponse selection by observable and unobservable worker characteristics that correlate with EE mobility. We propose a selection model and a procedure to impute missing answers. Our imputed EE aggregate series no longer trends down after 2000 and restores a close congruence with the business cycle after 2007. (JEL C83, E24, E32, J62)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视月度当前人口调查中雇主间（EE）转换的衡量问题。自2007年一月引入新的软件工具进行访谈以及2008-2009年实施受访者身份识别政策以来，关于雇主变更问题的缺失答案发生率急剧上升。我们记录了可观测和不可观测的工人特征导致的非随机无回答选择，这些特征与EE流动性相关。我们提出了一个选择模型和一种填补缺失答案的程序。我们填补后的EE总量序列在2000年后不再呈下降趋势，并在2007年后与商业周期恢复紧密一致性。（JEL C83, E24, E32, J62）

articles.title_en: Asymmetric Reciprocity and the Cyclical Behavior of Wages, Effort, and Job Creation
articles.title_cn: 非对称互惠与工资、努力和就业创造的周期行为
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a search and matching framework in which workers are characterized by asymmetric reference-dependent reciprocity and firms set wages by considering the effect that these can have on workers’ effort and, therefore, on output. The cyclical response of effort to wage changes can considerably amplify shocks, independently of the cyclicality of the hiring wage, which becomes irrelevant for unemployment volatility, and firms’ expectations of downward wage rigidity in existing jobs increases the volatility of job creation. The model is consistent with evidence on hiring and incumbents’ wage cyclicality, and provides novel predictions on the dynamics of effort. (JEL E24, E32, J23, J31, J41, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个搜索与匹配框架，其中工人具有非对称的参照依赖互惠特征，企业设定工资时考虑工资对工人努力及产出的影响。努力对工资变化的周期性反应可以显著放大冲击，且与雇佣工资的周期性无关，后者对失业波动变得无关紧要；企业对现有工作中工资下行刚性的预期增加了就业创造的波动性。该模型与关于雇佣和在职者工资周期性的证据一致，并对努力的动态提供了新的预测。（JEL E24, E32, J23, J31, J41, J64）

articles.title_en: Aggregate and Intergenerational Implications of School Closures: A Quantitative Assessment
articles.title_cn: 学校关闭的总体与代际影响：一项定量评估
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantitatively investigates the medium- and long-term macroeconomic and distributional consequences of school closures through intergenerational channels. The model economy is a dynastic overlapping-generations general equilibrium model in which schools, in the form of public education investments, complement parental investments in producing children’s human capital. We find that unexpected school closure shocks have long-lasting adverse effects on macroeconomic aggregates and reduce intergenerational mobility, especially among older children. Higher substitutability between public and private investments induces smaller damages in the aggregate economy and the affected children’s lifetime income while exacerbating negative impacts on intergenerational mobility and inequality. (JEL D31, E24, I26, I28, J22, J62)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文定量研究了学校关闭通过代际渠道对中期和长期宏观经济及分配后果的影响。模型经济是一个王朝重叠世代交叠一般均衡模型，其中学校以公共教育投资的形式，与 parental 投资互补，共同生产儿童的人力资本。我们发现，意外的学校关闭冲击对宏观经济总量产生持久的不利影响，并降低代际流动性，尤其是在年龄较大的儿童中。公共与私人投资之间的更高替代性会减少对总体经济和受影响儿童终身收入的损害，同时加剧对代际流动性和不平等的负面影响。(JEL D31, E24, I26, I28, J22, J62)

articles.title_en: Reassessing the Relevance of Financial Shocks in an Estimated Heterogeneous Firm Model
articles.title_cn: 重新评估金融冲击在估计的异质性企业模型中的相关性
articles.abstract_en: I study the transmission of financial shocks using an estimated heterogeneous firm model. Following a contractionary financial shock, financially constrained firms cut investment, but unconstrained firms increase investment due to the lower capital price and interest rate. After matching the empirical dynamics of prices and the price elasticity of investment, I find a limited role of the unconstrained firms’ response in dampening the aggregate investment decline. Nonfinancial capital adjustment friction is the key to generating this result. Without the capital adjustment friction, unconstrained firms’ investment becomes unrealistically sensitive to prices, and the model would understate the financial shocks’ aggregate relevance. (JEL D25, E12, E22, G31, G32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用一个估计的异质性企业模型研究金融冲击的传导。在紧缩性金融冲击之后，受到融资约束的企业削减投资，但未受约束的企业由于资本价格和利率下降而增加投资。在匹配了价格和投资价格弹性的经验动态之后，我发现未受约束企业的反应在抑制总体投资下降方面的作用有限。非金融资本调整摩擦是产生这一结果的关键。如果没有资本调整摩擦，未受约束企业的投资将对价格变得不切实际地敏感，模型将低估金融冲击的总体相关性。(JEL D25, E12, E22, G31, G32)

articles.abstract_en: We use a new growth accounting method to quantify the drivers of world total factor productivity (TFP) growth during 1996–2014 and uncover four main results. World productivity growth is volatile from year to year. This mainly reflects reallocation of labor across country-industries. The contribution of country-industry level productivity growth to world productivity is relatively constant over time. This constancy masks that the increased importance of emerging economies offsets a productivity slowdown in advanced economies. After 2008, this offsetting effect dissipated and world TFP growth declined. These conclusions are robust to the inclusion of markups in the analysis. (JEL E23, E32, O30, O47)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一种新的增长核算方法来量化1996-2014年间世界全要素生产率（TFP）增长的驱动因素，并揭示了四个主要结果。世界生产率增长逐年波动较大。这主要反映了劳动力在国家-行业间的重新配置。国家-行业层面生产率增长对世界生产率的贡献随时间相对稳定。这种稳定性掩盖了新兴经济体重要性的增加抵消了发达经济体生产率放缓的事实。2008年之后，这种抵消效应消失，世界TFP增长下降。这些结论在分析中加入加成定价后依然稳健。（JEL E23, E32, O30, O47）

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic Frameworks: Reconciling Evidence and Model Predictions from Demand Shocks
articles.title_cn: 宏观经济框架：调和需求冲击的证据与模型预测
articles.abstract_en: How do demand shocks affect the economy? We exploit detailed data on US defense spending to examine a large set of outcome variables in response to well-identified local demand shocks, jointly examining new outcomes (e.g., firm entry and housing rents) and other key macroeconomic outcomes and elasticities that previously have been estimated separately or in settings with weaker identification. We find that government spending crowds in employment, firm entry, private consumption, and labor productivity while also increasing local housing rents. To reconcile the evidence with theory, we study a model of economic slack. (JEL E12, E21, E24, E25, H56, L11, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 需求冲击如何影响经济？我们利用美国国防支出的详细数据，考察了在面对识别良好的局部需求冲击时的一系列结果变量，共同检验了新的结果（如企业进入和住房租金）以及其他关键宏观经济结果和弹性，这些此前要么被分别估计，要么在识别较弱的背景下估计。我们发现政府支出挤入就业、企业进入、私人消费和劳动生产率，同时也提高了当地住房租金。为了将证据与理论相调和，我们研究了一个经济松弛模型。（JEL E12, E21, E24, E25, H56, L11, R31）

articles.title_en: Optimal Foreign Reserves and Central Bank Policy under Financial Stress
articles.title_cn: 金融压力下的最优外汇储备与中央银行政策
articles.abstract_en: We study foreign reserves accumulation and liquidity policy in an open economy under financial stress. Firms and households finance investment and consumption by borrowing from banks, which borrow from abroad. Binding financial constraints cause the domestic interest rate to rise over the world rate and the exchange rate to depreciate, implying inefficiently low investment and consumption. A role emerges for a central bank that accumulates reserves to provide international liquidity when financial frictions bind. Our analysis yields novel insights on the determinants of optimal reserves accumulation cum liquidity provision and their role vis-à-vis capital flow management policies. (JEL E21, E22, E43, E58, F31, F41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了开放经济在金融压力下的外汇储备积累和流动性政策。企业和家庭通过向银行借款来为投资和消费融资，而银行则从国外借款。具有约束力的金融约束导致国内利率上升至世界利率之上，汇率贬值，这意味着投资和消费的低效率。当金融摩擦具有约束力时，中央银行积累储备以提供国际流动性的作用就出现了。我们的分析对最优储备积累兼流动性提供及其相对于资本流动管理政策的作用的决定因素提供了新的见解。(JEL E21, E22, E43, E58, F31, F41)

articles.title_en: Why Didn’t the College Premium Rise Everywhere? Employment Protection and On-the-Job Investment in Skills
articles.title_cn: 为什么大学教育溢价并非在所有地方都上升？就业保护与在职技能投资
articles.abstract_en: Why has the college wage premium risen rapidly in the United States since the 1980s but not in European economies such as Germany? We argue that differences in employment protection can account for much of the gap. We develop a model in which firms and workers make relationship-specific investments in skill accumulation. The incentive to invest is stronger when employment protection creates an expectation of long-lasting matches. We argue that changes in the economic environment have reduced relationship-specific investment for less educated workers in the United States, but not for better-protected workers in Germany. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, J41, J63)
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么自1980年以来，美国的大学教育工资溢价迅速上升，而在德国等欧洲经济体却没有？我们认为，就业保护的差异可以解释这一差距的很大一部分。我们开发了一个模型，其中企业和工人对技能积累进行关系特定投资。当就业保护创造了对长期匹配的预期时，投资的激励更强。我们认为，经济环境的变化减少了美国受教育程度较低的工人的关系特定投资，但对德国受到更好保护的工人则没有。(JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, J41, J63)

articles.title_en: Delayed Overshooting: The Case for Information Rigidities
articles.title_cn: 延迟超调：信息刚性的案例
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence that the delayed overshooting puzzle reflects a slow adjustment of exchange rate expectations to monetary policy shocks rather than a failure of uncovered interest parity. Consistent with this evidence, we put forward a New Keynesian model in which uncovered interest parity holds, but there are information rigidities: investors do not observe monetary policy shocks but learn rationally from unanticipated shifts in monetary policy about the state of the economy. We estimate the model and find it can account for the joint responses of the spot exchange rate, forward exchange rates, and excess currency returns to monetary policy shocks. (JEL D83, E12, E31, E43, E52, F31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，延迟超调之谜反映了汇率预期对货币政策冲击的缓慢调整，而非未抛补利率平价的失效。与这一证据一致，我们提出了一个新凯恩斯模型，其中未抛补利率平价成立，但存在信息刚性：投资者不观察货币政策冲击，而是从货币政策中未预期的变动中理性学习经济状态。我们估计了该模型，并发现它可以解释即期汇率、远期汇率和超额货币收益对货币政策冲击的联合反应。（JEL D83, E12, E31, E43, E52, F31）

articles.title_en: MPC Heterogeneity and the Dynamic Response of Consumption to Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: MPC异质性与消费对货币政策的动态响应
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how household financial choices affect the impact of monetary policy on consumption. Based on micro data from four major euro area countries, we estimate key structural parameters using a simulated method of moments approach to match moments related to asset market participation rates, portfolio shares, and wealth-to-income ratios by education and country. The country-specific distributions of marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) out of income and financial wealth are not degenerate. Due to this MPC heterogeneity, monetary policy, operating through income and asset returns, has a differential impact on individuals within and across countries. (JEL E21, E52, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究家庭金融选择如何影响货币政策对消费的影响。基于四个主要欧元区国家的微观数据，我们使用模拟矩方法估计关键结构参数，以匹配与资产市场参与率、投资组合份额以及按教育和国家划分的财富收入比相关的矩。收入与金融财富的边际消费倾向（MPCs）的国家特定分布并非退化。由于这种MPC异质性，货币政策通过收入和资产回报渠道，对国内及跨国个体产生差异化影响。（JEL E21, E52, G51）

articles.title_en: Understanding Persistent ZLB: Theory and Assessment
articles.title_cn: 理解持续性零利率下限：理论与评估
articles.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical framework that rationalizes two hypotheses of long-lasting low-interest rate episodes: deflationary-expectations-traps and secular stagnation in a unified setting. These hypotheses differ in the sign of the theoretical correlation between inflation and output growth that they imply. Using the data from Japan over 1998:I–2019:IV, we find that the data favor the expectations-trap hypothesis. The superior model fit of the expectations trap relies on its ability to generate the observed negative correlation between inflation and output growth. (JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个理论框架，在统一设定中合理化了长期低利率时期的两种假说：通缩预期陷阱和长期停滞。这两种假说在它们所隐含的通胀与产出增长之间的理论相关性符号上有所不同。利用日本1998年第一季度至2019年第四季度的数据，我们发现数据支持预期陷阱假说。预期陷阱的优越模型拟合依赖于其能够生成观察到的通胀与产出增长之间的负相关关系。（JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52）

articles.title_en: Crossing the Credit Channel: Credit Spreads and Firm Heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 穿越信贷渠道：信用利差与企业异质性
articles.abstract_en: Firms with high leverage experience a more pronounced increase in credit spreads than firms with low leverage in response to a monetary policy tightening. A large fraction of this increase is due to a component of credit spreads that is in excess of firms’ expected default risk. A stylized heterogeneous firm model with default risk, financially constrained intermediaries, and segmented financial markets is able to account for these facts. Our findings imply that financial intermediaries play an important role in shaping the transmission of monetary policy to firm-level outcomes. (JEL D22, E43, E44, E52, G32)
articles.abstract_cn: 高杠杆企业在面对货币政策收紧时，其信用利差的上升幅度比低杠杆企业更为显著。这一上升中有很大一部分来自于超出企业预期违约风险的信用利差成分。一个包含违约风险、金融中介受约束以及金融市场分割的典型异质性企业模型能够解释这些事实。我们的研究结果表明，金融中介在塑造货币政策向企业层面结果的传导中发挥着重要作用。（JEL D22, E43, E44, E52, G32）
